note: Test whether much greater root rectification at substantially lower pressure finally removes the n-pentane leakage that currently destroys both main blends.
notebook:

If this makes C5/C6 saleable, tune cost downward; otherwise reconsider the cut or operating ratios. Ideal blend revenues: C5 ~$607M/yr, C6 paraffin ~$974M/yr, C4 ~$176M/yr, C3 ~$65M/yr, naphthenes ~$396M/yr.
